description: Coupang best-seller products, keyword suggestions, or category nodes. Product records include current/original price, unit price, coupon, rating, Rocket delivery, and a category breadcrumb. Best sellers are limited to 30 products per page; optional child-category fan-out continues until maxItems. Search, product details, and reviews require a Korean residential proxy.
